result:
**Verdict: PASS. No new findings.** My review record, verifications sidecar and narrative for DG1 round 4 are written, and the record passes a manual check against the review schema.

**Candidate.** The recomputed candidate ID matches the assigned `sha256:6e0c0db1…f827` (395 files), both on the main checkout and on a disposable clone of the frozen commit 642e6bf. HEAD moved during my run because the runner auto-committed the domain reviewer's run evidence. Commits after 642e6bf change only delivery records, and I didn't open the other reviewer's record. Since round 3, the only code change is two files: the new `apps/web/tsconfig.e2e.json` and the `typecheck` script in `apps/web/package.json`.

**F-DG1-147 (Low) is verified and marked CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
- The new e2e project compiles exactly `apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts` and the root `playwright.config.ts`, with the same strict settings as the rest of the code.
- CI covers it: `ci.yml:64` runs `pnpm typecheck`, which runs `pnpm -r typecheck`.
- **Fail-then-pass:** I added three deliberate errors, one at a time: a wrong type in the spec, a wrong type in `playwright.config.ts`, and a call to a method that doesn't exist on Playwright's `Locator`. Each made typecheck fail with exit 2, and each passed again once removed. The third error shows Playwright's types are really checked, not silently treated as `any`.

**No regression.** Apart from those two files, nothing under `apps/` or `packages/` changed. The round-2 fixes (BU hierarchy guard and migration 0009, destination authorization, rate-limit keying) are identical to round 3.

**Checks.** All ran on Node 22 in the disposable clone; unit tests also ran on Node 24.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck` (now includes e2e) | Pass |
| Build, lint, OpenAPI lint, no-CDN scan, format check | Pass |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and Node 24 | 326/326 on each |
| Integration tests, two runs on fresh PostgreSQL 16.13 (ports 55149 and 55286) | 209/209 both times |
| Gate and agent tests | 105/105 |
| Deploy script tests | 59/59 |
| SBOM check | OK |
| DG0 historical validation | PASS |
| Three `ci.yml` copies | Byte-identical |

The install sandbox passed 13 of 14 checks offline. The one failure, "AC-1 (effect)", needs a live package registry, so I recorded it as the documented residual D-057, as the assignment instructed. The live CI run is the documented residual D-058.

**Observation (not a finding):** the qa-owned root spec `e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts` is still not type-checked by any project. It type-checks cleanly when I run it ad hoc, so there is no current defect. I didn't raise a finding because the assignment scoped it out and it's a single spec that the CI e2e job runs. I recommended adding it to the e2e typecheck when qa next promotes tests.

The disposable clone, package store copy and PostgreSQL clusters have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-4/`:
- code-security-reviewer.json
- code-security-reviewer.verifications.json
- code-security-reviewer.md

Check logs are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/code-security/round-4/`.
